name: Plants Vs 99 Nights In The Forest 🔦
desc:
Welcome to Plants Vs 99 Nights In The Forest!

How to Play:
🌱 Plant seeds to grow your garden!
🌻 Summon plants to battle 99 Nights Characters!
💸 Defeat Characters to earn money!
🍄 Collect epic plants & flex on your 99 Nights Characters!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
